docs.title: ChatEvent
docs.text:
ChatEvent 捕获已授权社区里的动作，统一保存为事件，再通过网页、命令行和接口展示与过滤。采集配置决定抓什么，保存视图决定看什么；Agent 框架自行决定如何行动。

平台 webhook / 事件队列 / API 快照 → ChatEvent → SQLite → 服务端查询 / Observatory

  • 接入社区

    配置 Zulip 官方事件队列、Discourse 签名 webhook 或只读主题回填。

    注册采集范围 · 动作覆盖

  • 筛选需要的信息

    组合来源、动作、作者、目标、标签和时间条件；先筛选，再分页，保存为可复用视图。

    过滤与视图

  • 让工具和 Agent 读取

    Python、REST 和 CLI 使用同一套查询语义；按稳定游标读取新增事实。

    快速开始 · 接口参考

  • 查看完整能力

    真实命令树、接口树与实现状态，避免把平台目录误认为已接通能力。

    CLI 树 · 接口树 · 发行说明

docs.title: 运行与边界
docs.text:
默认数据库位于 ChatEnv 的 <chatarch-home>/chatevent/events.db；兼容 $CHATARCH_HOME/chatevent/events.db 与 ~/.chatarch/chatevent/events.db。使用 chatevent paths --json 回读实际位置，使用 chatevent --tree 查看真实命令。

ChatEvent 不运行 Agent，不提供唤醒派发、任务分配或通用发帖网关。保存订阅不等于采集器已运行；平台目录的 capture_status 区分已实现与仅目录动作。采集只覆盖当前凭据可见的数据，查询过滤不能扩大权限。Voice 始终只保留元数据。
• 社区多动作采集、结构化查询、游标分页、保存视图和事件权限边界；详见过滤与视图与平台动作覆盖。

• Web 登录接入 ChatLogin 共享核心，保留 EventStore 用户、角色、启用状态、API token 和既有 PBKDF2 字符串格式。
  • 浏览器 session 改用 ChatLogin SessionManager + MemorySessionStore，支持 TTL、容量上限、登录轮换和登出撤销。
  • Cookie 认证的用户、token、订阅写操作现在要求 X-CSRF-Token；验证成功的 arch_xxx API token 和 legacy bootstrap admin token 继续免 CSRF。
  • 默认登录页改为 ChatLogin LoginUI 与公共 assets，dashboard 和 CLI username-password 模式会携带 CSRF。

• 新增 Speakr/ChatVoice 平台目录：source=voice，支持 talk.created / talk.updated action。
  • 新增 capture voice-backfill 与 capture voice-once，通过 ChatVoice read-only data API 捕获 talk metadata。
  • Voice payload 只保存 talk ID、标题、tags、时间、时长和摘要/转写可用性布尔值，不保存 summary/transcript/preview 正文或 token。
  • Incremental capture 会比较上一条已存事件的 tag snapshot；即使 updated_at 不变，tag-only 更新也会生成 talk.updated 并通过 metadata fingerprint 去重。

• 新增 X/Twitter 平台目录：source=x，支持 post.created action，并区分当前网页 URL 获取路径 x-web-url。
  • 新增 capture x-user 与 capture x-status，可通过公开 X 用户页 / status URL 捕获 post 并写入 Event 历史。
  • X normalizer 记录作者、正文、原始 URL、发布时间、target chain、raw payload 和 acquisition metadata；重复轮询会走现有 dedupe/seen_count。
  • README、CLI tree、平台 action 文档和测试同步覆盖 X 支持。

• 补齐标准 ChatStyle brief tree 入口：新增 chatevent --tree-brief，保留命令节点和说明但省略参数签名。
  • 同步 CLI tree 文档、README、reference 和测试，确保 --tree / --tree-brief 都是可验收入口。

• 对齐标准 Chat 系列包规范：新增 click、chatstyle、chatenv 依赖。
  • chatevent --tree 改为由 ChatStyle 渲染的标准 CLI 树，保留现有 argparse 命令执行路径。
  • 新增 chatevent.config:ChatEventConfig 并注册到 ChatEnv chatenv.configs entry point。
  • 默认运行态路径优先使用 ChatEnv get_paths().home_dir，同时保留 CHATARCH_HOME、CHATEVENT_DB 和旧库迁移兼容。
  • MkDocs 改为标准分组导航，新增 CLI 树 与 接口树 中英文页面。

• 修正登录模型：Web 主页改为账号密码登录，arch_xxx token 不再作为网页登录凭据。
  • 新增 password hash 存储与 bootstrap 管理员账号初始化：CHATEVENT_BOOTSTRAP_USERNAME + CHATEVENT_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD_FILE。
  • 新增 API Token 生成接口：POST /api/me/token 与 POST /api/users/{id}/token；token 仅用于 CLI、模型或程序代表账号调用 API。
  • Web 登录后可直接编辑订阅；CLI/API 可用 token，也可通过用户名 + 密码文件先登录后操作。

• 新增登录页 gate：配置管理员 token 或用户后，未登录访问 / 只显示登录页，不能直接进入 Observatory。
  • 新增 /api/login / /api/logout cookie 登录流程；读取型 API 在需要登录时会返回 401。
  • 主题切换按钮从“黑底/白底”改为“☾ 夜间 / ☀ 日间”。

• 高级事件类型列表现在会合并平台 action catalog 与当前已观察到的来源事件类型。
  • GitHub action catalog 补充 workflow_run.requested 与 workflow_run.in_progress。
  • 新增轻量登录与用户管理骨架（0.1.5 已修正为账号密码网页登录 + API Token 机制）：/api/session、/api/users 和 CLI api create-user。
  • Subscription.owner_user_id 为 member 用户订阅隔离打基础，管理员仍可管理全部订阅。

• Observatory 顶层筛选收敛为来源和时间下拉框，其余筛选进入高级选项。
  • 高级选项支持按来源联动的事件类型多选、订阅/渠道多选、关键词和自定义时间范围。
  • Platform actions 的 action chip 可点击打开详情，查看 action kind、target types、捕获方式、webhook events 和 API 大致含义。
  • 页面头部新增 GitHub / Docs 图标链接，并支持黑底/白底主题切换。

• 新增开放式 CarrierTarget / ActionDescriptor / ActorDescriptor，记录动作、承载目标链和发起人角色。
  • Observatory 显示 Target 列，事件详情显示 Action、Action target、Target chain 与 Actor role。

第一个完整 Event Hub 版本，重点是把 ChatEvent 从事件模型骨架推进为可运行、可观察、可消费的 ChatArch 系列服务包。

  • 默认运行态归入 ChatArch 内部：$CHATARCH_HOME/chatevent/ 或 ~/.chatarch/chatevent/。
  • events.db 保存事件账本和订阅配置；secrets/admin-token 可作为管理员 token 文件。
  • chatevent paths --json 可回读默认目录和配置状态，不输出 token 值。
  • 旧版 ~/.chatevent/events.db 会在首次默认启动时复制到新位置，旧文件保留。
  • Web Observatory 支持 Event Stream / Subscriptions / Platform actions 三个标签页。
  • Subscriptions 支持新建、编辑、启停和删除；可用管理员 token 保护写操作。
  • REST API 与 chatevent api ... CLI 对齐，可写入事件、查询事件流、读取具体事件、管理订阅。
  • 支持 Discourse、Zulip、Gitea、GitHub 的官方事件捕获和 normalizer。
初始事件 envelope 和 monitor protocol 占位版本。

docs.title: Community capture and execution
docs.text:
The community companion is opt-in. The Observatory can keep running a published ChatEvent release while the companion runs a separately pinned source revision. It never turns an ordinary capture subscription into permission to execute.

chatevent community serve --config ~/.chatarch/community/config.json
chatevent community status --config ~/.chatarch/community/config.json
chatevent community worker --config ~/.chatarch/community/worker.json

The real chatevent --tree includes these commands. Store trusted registry and configuration under ChatArch home with owner-only permissions. Store secrets in ChatEnv / TokenStore, and reference their paths in configuration. No account key, webhook secret, event body, result database or runtime log belongs in Git.

Zulip uses the official register / events blocking event queue. Only native rendered user mentions from authorized humans in permitted channels enter the inbox. Quotes, code, ordinary name text, registered Agent authors and unrelated channels do not start a model. Per-account queues preserve private visibility; reconnect registers a queue before bounded message catch-up and commits progress after durable capture. A catch-up backlog must complete before live delivery.

Discourse sends only post_created webhooks for explicitly permitted categories. The receiver checks the exact configured instance and HMAC-SHA256 body signature, uses native numeric author IDs and parsed mention links, and commits the inbox before returning HTTP 202. Private-network URL exceptions, if required by the installation, must name one reviewed destination rather than disable SSRF checks.

The capture outbox writes ChatEvent first, then enqueues a dispatch. These are separate transactions, recoverable by stable native event identity. The companion does not alter the Observatory's authentication, accounts or old collectors. The dispatch contract describes execution/reply states, binding snapshots, interrupted-work quarantine and the native Hermes capability binding. A model reply is not proof of a coding/deployment/Sandbox task.

For an Agent on a different machine, an outbound worker uses an existing SSH transport and a loopback forward to the private companion. It long-polls for its own jobs using a dedicated credential. No inbound public worker port is needed. Its trusted local configuration selects the model home/interpreter; the central registry cannot substitute local execution paths. A job is claimed once. When a trusted operator configures timeout_seconds, a result accepted before that deadline remains usable even if the central waiter wakes later; a late result is retained for reconciliation, not promoted to success. Omitting the optional deadline permits an indefinite serial wait: a disconnected worker can hold later invocations until operator intervention. The identity-bound sender replies only after a durable result is returned. Idle workers make no model calls. Lost acknowledgments retry the stored result, not the model. Expired or interrupted central execution requires reconciliation and is never automatically replayed.

The companion handles new channel/forum mentions and can bind native configured Hermes tools for real workspace tasks. Direct messages, edited-message execution, arbitrary Agent-to-Agent wakeups and automatic interrupts are separate ingress capabilities. Add runtime bindings by their verified capabilities rather than treating an account registration as an online executor.

docs.title: Community dispatch companion contract
docs.text: This opt-in companion is separate from ChatEvent ingestion and does not change capture subscriptions into execution permissions. Runtime configuration, SQLite state, private inputs and outputs belong under ~/.chatarch/community/. Capturing an event or returning an enqueue receipt does not prove execution completed.

docs.title: Registry (trusted operator configuration)
docs.text:
{
  "version": 1,
  "human_actor_ids": {"zulip": ["user:1001"], "discourse": ["user:1001"]},
  "ignored_actor_ids": {"zulip": ["user:2001"], "discourse": ["user:2002"]},
  "agents": [{
    "agent_id": "agent-worker",
    "enabled": true,
    "bindings": {
      "zulip": {"account_id": "user:2001", "instance": "https://zulip.example.org", "profile": "~/.chatarch/envs/Zulip/agent-worker.env", "allowed_stream_ids": [3001]},
      "discourse": {"account_id": "user:2002", "instance": "https://forum.example.org", "profile": "~/.chatarch/envs/Discourse/agent-worker-community.env", "allowed_category_ids": [4001]}
    },
    "runtime": {
      "kind": "hermes",
      "python": "/absolute/committed/venv/bin/python",
      "source": "/absolute/existing/hermes-agent",
      "home": "/absolute/existing/hermes-home",
      "cwd": "/absolute/authorized/workspace",
      "timeout_seconds": 3600,
      "approval_mode": "native"
    }
  }]
}

Include all known Agent community IDs as bindings (or in ignored_actor_ids), even when an entry is disabled. All registered Agent authors are ignored before mention matching. Only explicitly listed human IDs may trigger; scopes match allowed native stream/category IDs, with no wildcard; capture must set metadata.community_scope to stream:ID or category:ID, and the matching native ID must exist in raw_payload.message.stream_id / raw_payload.post.category_id. Topics may vary inside those permitted containers. Account instance must equal the normalized event instance. An enabled binding is snapshotted at enqueue and cannot change an in-flight invocation. Registry holds paths/references, never credential values. The examples are placeholders, not existing permissions.

docs.title: Capture → enqueue
docs.text:
store = DispatchStore(db_path)
receipt = store.enqueue(event, mentions=["user:2001"], registry=registry)

event is a validated ChatEvent or its dictionary. mentions must come from the capture layer's platform-native, authenticated mention parsing, never an LLM or a regex over arbitrary display names. Root capture preserves canonical IDs and authenticated original message fields. The dispatcher accepts new Zulip message.created and Discourse post.created / reply.created facts only, ignores bot/system authors and all registered Agent identities, checks human/scopes/instance, then deduplicates (source, instance, source event id, agent_id). To dedupe separate collectors of the same message, it prefers the stable source subject_id for these create facts over queue delivery IDs.

Receipt: {"dispatch_ids":["..."],"duplicate":false,"ignored_reason":null}. Ignored facts return an empty ID list and a machine-readable reason. Repeated delivery returns the existing IDs with duplicate:true. A conflicting replay of the same source message is rejected rather than replacing the original payload.

docs.title: Worker / adapter / reply sender
docs.text:
worker = DispatchWorker(store, adapters={"hermes": adapter}, reply_sender=sender)
receipt = worker.run_once()

adapter(invocation: dict) -> dict returns:

{"status":"succeeded","text":"actual final output","session_id":"runtime-issued-or-null","runtime_status":"completed","evidence":{}}

Statuses: succeeded, failed, waiting_for_user, cancelled, unknown. A success requires nonempty output and real completion evidence. Adapter exceptions are unknown, not an automatic re-execution. No return value or text prefix proves success on its own.

sender(invocation: dict, result: dict) -> dict must use the invocation's snapshotted agent_id and account binding (binding.account_id), reply only to the source message/conversation, and return {"id":"native-reply-id","identity_id":"user:2001"} after platform acceptance. It must not substitute owner credentials. Failure/ambiguous network outcome leaves reply_state=unknown; retry requires explicit reconciliation to avoid duplicate posts. Dispatch ID is available as a reconciliation marker.

One run_once() claims at most one invocation or one already-computed pending reply. Execution states are queued/running/succeeded/failed/waiting_for_user/cancelled/unknown; reply states are not_ready/pending/sending/sent/unknown. Database transactions claim work before side effects. A cross-process worker lock serializes workers; after owning that lock, recovery changes interrupted running/sending states to unknown, never replays them. Completed results and replies are durably recorded separately. No queue means no adapter/model call. Definitive failures may receive a bounded failure reply; ambiguous outcomes stay unknown without automatic retries.

docs.title: Native Hermes capability binding
docs.text:
The adapter uses the existing Hermes interpreter, model resolver, configured CLI toolsets and MCP discovery. It loads native workspace context, SOUL identity, memory, skills and SessionDB. Work starts at the configured workspace root; tasks read AGENTS.md and projects/README.md, create the required dated project/PRD/progress records, validate their changes and commit understood edits. Native tools operate with the existing host user's permissions.

runtime.approval_mode is native by default. An operator may explicitly bind full after authorizing that agent's work: the adapter uses Hermes' auditable session-scoped full approval API and clears it in finally. It does not call the CLI's implicit-YOLO oneshot path or alter global approval configuration. Existing native user deny/hardline policies still apply. The adapter does not impose a two-turn or fixed output-token demonstration budget; configured native iteration limits are preserved. An optional operator lifecycle deadline can be configured independently.

The private request file survives interpreter re-execution; implicit bootstrap installation is disabled. Each execution has its own process group and private diagnostics under ChatArch home. The source revision is verified, actual completion is recorded, and interrupted/ambiguous work is never automatically re-executed.

docs.title: Visible task acknowledgements
docs.text:
A durable status projection is created with each newly accepted invocation. It is delivered by a separate model-free worker: queued/received, running, succeeded, failed, unknown, waiting_for_user or cancelled. Central claim and remote claim do not prove work has started. The Hermes child writes a private marker immediately before invoking its agent turn, after native initialization; the parent sends an idempotent started callback. Outbound workers acknowledge that boundary through their authenticated started endpoint.

Zulip switches only the invoked account's managed reaction on the original message. Discourse uses one own-author status post and edits it in the original topic with a separate minimally scoped status credential. A status receipt is independently read back before it is considered delivered. Ambiguous new-post creation is quarantined or recovered from its known native post ID; it is never blindly repeated. Status failures cannot block execution, change its result or cause another model turn. Received status can coalesce to a later truthful state when processing completes quickly.

docs.title: 过滤、游标与保存视图
docs.text: ChatEvent 采集范围由上游 Subscription 与平台权限决定。SavedView 只保存查询定义，不启动采集器，也不包含 Agent 模型、唤醒 URL 或任务分配。Agent 框架决定何时消费事实和如何行动。

docs.title: 条件表达式
docs.text:
叶子节点为 {"field":"source","op":"eq","value":"zulip"}。组合节点为 {"all":[...]}、{"any":[...]} 或 {"not":{...}}；最多 6 层、64 节点，in 最多 50 项，文本值最长 1024 字符。未知字段、操作符、格式和过深表达式在数据库查询前被拒绝。没有任意 SQL、eval 或正则操作符。

字段 类型 说明 source, instance, kind, subscription_id 文本 来源、实例、动作、采集订阅 action.kind, action.object_type, action.verb 文本 结构化动作，可跨平台按动词或对象筛选 actor.id, actor.type, actor.role, actor_id, actor_role 文本 发起者身份和角色；可在查询中排除 bot/self subject_id, subject_type, conversation_id 文本 被作用对象及会话 target.type, target.key, target.parent.type, target.parent.key, target.parent.parent.type, target.parent.parent.key 文本 承载目标和直接父级 tags 数组 contains 为精确成员匹配；in/any 为交集，all 要求全部成员 occurred_at, captured_at 时间 带时区 ISO 8601；SQLite 时间比较精度约毫秒 url, payload.title, payload.content, payload.text, payload.topic, payload.stream, payload.post_number, payload.topic_id, payload.emoji_code, payload.from_topic, payload.from_stream, payload.sender_id, payload.name 文本 声明过的展示字段 payload.score 数值 声明过的数值扩展字段 metadata.timestamp_source, metadata.event_name 文本 声明过的元数据

eq、ne、in 适用于标量（in 列表不含 null）；tags 支持 in/any（任一成员）、all（全部成员）、contains（单个成员）和 exists。文本 contains 不区分大小写；exists 接受布尔值；gt、gte、lt、lte、between 仅适用于时间或数值。数值/时间比较不会将字符串自动转换。缺失字段不匹配叶子（exists:false 除外）；显式 JSON null 算存在，只匹配 eq:null。ne 不包含缺失或类型不符的字段。not 对叶子结果取反，因此能包含缺失字段。JSON path 和值均作为 SQLite 参数绑定；不允许动态未声明路径。

示例：

{"all":[
  {"field":"source","op":"eq","value":"zulip"},
  {"any":[{"field":"kind","op":"eq","value":"message.created"},{"field":"kind","op":"eq","value":"reaction.added"}]},
  {"not":{"field":"actor.role","op":"eq","value":"bot"}}
]}

docs.title: 查询和分页
docs.text:
先在服务端过滤，再分页。sort=desc 按不可变入库序号浏览新事件；sort=asc 可顺序读取积压。limit 为 1–500，默认 100。响应含 items、count、next_cursor、has_more。处理成功后保存最后非空页的 next_cursor；即使 has_more=false，后续增量轮询仍用这个游标。空页时保留之前的游标。改变 filter、sort 或账号后必须重新开始，混用游标会返回 422。重复投递只增加 seen_count，不会生成新序号；同一捕获时间的事件不会因时间并列漏掉。新写入事件不会出现在已开始的 desc 旧页前面；刷新首页可看到它们。

旧 GET /api/events 仍可浏览并接收原有简写参数。其 next_since 是单页最新捕获时间，不是无损积压消费游标。

chatevent api query --filter-file filter.json --sort asc --limit 50
chatevent api query --filter-file filter.json --sort asc --cursor '<next_cursor>' --limit 50
chatevent api query --source zulip --kind message.created --sort desc

curl --get 'https://events.example.org/api/query' \
  -H "X-ChatEvent-Admin-Token: $CHATEVENT_ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  --data-urlencode 'filter@filter.json' --data-urlencode 'sort=asc' --data-urlencode 'limit=50'

import os
from chatevent.client import ChatEventApiClient
client = ChatEventApiClient(base_url="https://events.example.org", admin_token=os.environ["CHATEVENT_ADMIN_TOKEN"])
condition = {"field": "source", "op": "eq", "value": "zulip"}
page = client.query_events(filter=condition, sort="asc", limit=50)
while True:
    for item in page["items"]:
        print(item["event"]["kind"], item["event"]["subject_id"])
    if not page["has_more"]:
        break
    page = client.query_events(filter=condition, sort="asc", limit=50, cursor=page["next_cursor"])

docs.title: 保存视图
docs.text:
POST /api/views 接收 name、filter、sort；返回服务器生成的 id 和当前账号 owner_user_id。member 的 GET /api/views、GET /api/views/{id}、PUT /api/views/{id}、DELETE /api/views/{id} 均限定其 owner；admin 可查看并管理全部视图。GET /api/query?view_id=<id> 使用视图定义；无需保存也可直接传 filter。网页的多选/高级 JSON 生成同一表达式，并支持保存、加载、删除和翻页。

cat > view.json <<'JSON'
{"name":"Community messages","filter":{"field":"kind","op":"in","value":["message.created","reply.created"]},"sort":"asc"}
JSON
chatevent api save-view view.json
chatevent api views
chatevent api query --view-id '<view_id>' --limit 50
chatevent api delete-view '<view_id>'

member 只能查询捕获时归属自己的事件；admin 可查询全部事件。历史权限保存在不可变的事件归属列中，不随订阅删除或编辑转移。订阅 ID 首次绑定的 owner 不可更换，删除后也不能由其他 owner 复用。未能确定归属的旧事件只对 admin 可见。过滤条件和视图都不能扩大权限。

不同 owner 的相同平台事件使用独立存储去重键。读取详情时使用写入回执或列表项的 dedupe_key；不要用来源对象 ID 自行拼接存储键。规范化事件中的原生 id / subject_id 不变。事件响应包含原始 payload，因此应按账号授权保护 API 凭据。

docs.text:
以下名称与当前源码导出及 FastAPI 注册路由一致；CLI 树单独从实际 render_cli_tree() 执行结果生成。

├── model.py          ChatEvent, CaptureMode, ActorDescriptor, CarrierTarget
├── query.py          SavedView, FilterError, validate_filter(), compile_filter()
├── subscription.py   Subscription
├── store.py          EventStore, StoredEvent, QueryPage
│   └── record_event(), query_events(), list_events(), save_view(), list_views(), get_view(), delete_view(), stats()
├── adapters.py       normalize_zulip_message_event(), normalize_zulip_queue_event()
│                     normalize_discourse_post(), normalize_discourse_webhook()
│                     normalize_gitea_issue(), normalize_github_event()
├── capture.py        capture_zulip_once(), capture_zulip_subscription_once()
│                     capture_discourse_topic_backfill(), capture_subscription_once()
├── client.py         ChatEventApiClient.query_events(), list_views(), get_view(), save_view(), update_view(), delete_view()
├── server.py         create_app()
├── dashboard.py      DASHBOARD_HTML
├── config.py         ChatEventConfig (ChatEnv entry point)
└── cli.py            build_parser(), render_cli_tree(), main()

GET    /api/platforms           能力目录

GET    /api/subscriptions/{id}  采集配置详情
DELETE /api/subscriptions/{id}  删除采集配置
GET    /api/query               有界条件、服务端过滤、序号游标
GET    /api/events              兼容旧读接口
GET    /api/events/{key}        事件详情
POST   /api/events              授权的规范化入库
GET    /api/views               owner 视图列表
POST   /api/views               新建 owner 视图
GET    /api/views/{id}          owner 视图详情
PUT    /api/views/{id}          更新 owner 视图
DELETE /api/views/{id}          删除 owner 视图
GET    /api/stats               授权范围内统计
POST   /webhooks/discourse      需签名或授权 ingest 凭据

POST   /webhooks/gitea          需授权 ingest 凭据

EventStore 在 SQLite 中保持旧 events 行，添加 event_offsets 和 saved_views。query_events() 按 owner 限制；validate_filter() 在查询前限制路径、类型、深度和节点数。CHATEVENT_DB、CHATEVENT_ADMIN_TOKEN(_FILE)、CHATEVENT_BOOTSTRAP_USERNAME、CHATEVENT_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD_FILE 继续沿用 ChatEnv/服务配置；Discourse webhook 另有 CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_WEBHOOK_SECRET(_FILE)、CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_INSTANCE 与 CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID。默认库兼容 $CHATARCH_HOME/chatevent/events.db 与 ~/.chatarch/chatevent/events.db。

详细语义见接口参考与过滤与视图。

docs.title: 注册采集范围
docs.text: Subscription 描述上游平台、目标、授权范围和动作范围；SavedView 是对已入库事件的查询。保存或启用订阅不会启动后台 collector。平台凭据仍由平台的 ChatEnv profile 或服务 secret 文件管理。

docs.title: 创建订阅
docs.text:
账号 API token 通过 CHATEVENT_ADMIN_TOKEN 提供；以下请求由服务端把 member 的 owner_user_id 绑定为当前账号。

curl -X POST 'https://events.example.org/api/subscriptions' \
  -H "X-ChatEvent-Admin-Token: $CHATEVENT_ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"id":"zulip-community","source":"zulip","target":"stream:community/topic:news","event_kinds":["*"],"capture_modes":["event_queue"]}'

member 的事件查询只会看到其拥有订阅关联的事实。无订阅归属的历史事件仅管理员可见。查询视图不能扩大这个权限。

docs.title: Zulip 事件队列
docs.text:
在操作员管理的 env 文件中配置 ZULIP_SITE、ZULIP_BOT_EMAIL、ZULIP_BOT_API_KEY（或兼容的 Actor 名称）；不要把值放入文档、Git 或 CLI 参数。

chatevent capture zulip-once --env-file ./zulip.env --subscription-id zulip-community --timeout 30

命令注册一个官方队列，请求消息创建、编辑/移动、单条/批量删除、reaction、stream、subscription 和 realm_user 事件，按类型分发后删除队列。输出 captured、created、unsupported、scope_unknown、control，可判断这一轮覆盖。带 --stream/--topic 的窄范围模式对缺少可验证上下文的稀疏事件按 fail-closed 跳过并增加 scope_unknown。--content 会真实发送消息，仅供明确练习。每次新建队列之间有潜在缺口；需要持续运行时，采用有界但足够长的捕获窗口及外部监督，不能把反复短轮询说成完整队列历史。

已有的 capture subscription-once --subscription-id zulip-community 是 message ID 游标 topic 回填，读取当前可见的消息创建；它不恢复队列断开期间的 reaction 或编辑历史，也不能恢复已删除消息。

docs.title: Discourse webhook 与只读回填
docs.text:
在 Discourse 管理界面把 webhook URL 指向 https://events.example.org/webhooks/discourse，选中动作覆盖表中的 core 事件，并设置平台 webhook secret。ChatEvent 服务端配置：

CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_WEBHOOK_SECRET_FILE=<operator-managed-secret-file>
CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_INSTANCE=https://forum.example.org
CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID=discourse-community

绑定的订阅必须预先存在且 source=discourse。ChatEvent 用原始请求体验证 X-Discourse-Event-Signature: sha256=...，读取 X-Discourse-Event 动作名与 X-Discourse-Event-Type 包装类型。X-Discourse-Instance 只有在与已配置的实例绑定一致时才被接受为路由依据；不要仅凭不可信 header 或 payload 赋值 owner/instance。未配置签名 secret 时，webhook 需要授权的 ChatEvent API token 或 session。其他平台 webhook 在配置认证时同样需要授权 ingest 凭据。

只读、限量的当前 topic/posts 快照：

chatevent capture discourse-topic-backfill --base-url https://forum.example.org --topic-id 18 --limit 50 --subscription-id discourse-community --api-key-env DISCOURSE_API_KEY --api-username api-user

DISCOURSE_API_KEY 由调用环境提供。该命令读取 /t/{id}.json 和最多 100 个 /posts/{id}.json，只写本地 ChatEvent 数据库，不修改 Discourse。快照只表示当前可见对象，不重建历史编辑、删除或恢复。Discourse webhook 重试可能生成新的 delivery-row ID；去重使用动作、对象、修订/时间和规范化 payload 指纹，不仅靠 X-Discourse-Event-Id。

观察捕获结果：

chatevent api stats
chatevent api query --source discourse --sort desc --limit 50

Voice 始终只保存 metadata；平台 action catalog 是能力目录，不等于 collector 已运行。完整过滤方式见过滤与视图。

docs.title: 平台动作覆盖
docs.text:
下表描述适配器和采集器实际支持的动作，均有自动化载荷与接口测试。生产接入还需要按实际凭据、权限和平台版本验证。/api/platforms 的 capture_status=implemented 表示有实现；catalog_only 仅表示平台概念，不能据此承诺已捕获。保存 Subscription 不会自动启动采集器。

平台入口 上游事件或动作 规范化 kind 覆盖边界 Zulip 官方 queue message message.created 保留 bot/agent 活动；按实例+原生消息 ID 去重 Zulip queue update_message message.edited, message.moved, message.rendered / message.updated 同一移动事件可展开多个消息；内容编辑只指对应消息 Zulip queue delete_message message.deleted 单条 message_id 与批量 message_ids Zulip queue reaction add/remove reaction.added, reaction.removed 稀疏事件的 topic scope 需要已知消息上下文 Zulip queue stream create/update/delete stream.created/updated/deleted create 列表可展开 Zulip queue subscription add/remove/update subscription.added/removed/updated 列表可展开；不把 peer 事件假称订阅动作 Zulip queue realm_user add/update/remove user.added/updated/removed 被修改用户是 subject，不能无依据当作 actor Discourse webhook post_created post.created 或 reply.created post_number > 1 为 reply；兼容旧 normalize_discourse_post() Discourse webhook post_edited, post_destroyed, post_recovered post.edited/deleted/recovered 同一 post 的不同变更保留为不同事实 Discourse webhook topic_created, topic_edited, topic_revised, topic_destroyed, topic_recovered topic.created/edited/revised/deleted/recovered 上游 wrapped topic 对象 Discourse webhook user_created, user_updated, user_approved, user_suspended, user_unsuspended, user_destroyed user.created/updated/approved/suspended/unsuspended/deleted 被作用 user 是 subject；缺少显式 actor 时保持未知 Discourse webhook category/tag/group create/update/destroy category.*, tag.*, group.* 各 3 类、共 9 个上游名字 Discourse webhook like_created, notification_created, group_user_added/removed like.created, notification.created, group_user.added/removed 仅 payload 有稳定对象/成员身份时入库 Discourse topic API 当前 topic 和当前 posts topic.created, post.created / reply.created 快照 有界只读回填；不重建历史变更

Zulip 注册 7 个队列事件类型；Discourse 显式映射 28 个上游事件名。计数表示实现覆盖，不是平台全部事件或生产验收结果。协议依据见 Zulip 事件 API、队列注册、Discourse 事件目录和投递格式与签名。

Zulip heartbeat/restart 是控制事件，不伪装成消息。未知类型计入 unsupported；无法验证的 topic/stream 范围计入 scope_unknown 并跳过。realm_user_groups、其他 Zulip 类型及 Discourse 插件事件不在当前适配范围，也不宣称支持 like_removed。队列断开期间的 edit/reaction 和未投递 webhook 没有历史补偿保证。bot 活动不在采集阶段一概丢弃；通过过滤条件控制显示，角色只能在源信息已知时使用。

Zulip 的原生删除/移除事件是相对于当前观察账号而言，也可能表示失去可见性或频道归档，不能据此断言平台对象被永久删除。频道与订阅更新保留 payload.property / payload.value，完整来源载荷仍在 raw_payload。

原生对象 ID 是 subject_id；变更事件有自己的 id。instance 可区分平台实例，重复投递稳定去重，修改、删除和恢复各保留事实。源时间存在时用于 occurred_at，否则 metadata.timestamp_source=capture-time 表明使用捕获时间。

docs.title: 快速开始
docs.text: ChatEvent 负责捕获、规范化、保存和查询社区事实。Agent 的唤醒、运行、调度和任务分配由 Agent 框架决定。

docs.title: 安装
docs.text:
在源码检出目录：

python -m pip install -e '.[serve]'
chatevent --tree
chatevent --tree-brief
chatevent paths --json
chatevent serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765

打开 http://127.0.0.1:8765/。默认数据库由 ChatEnv 管理，兼容 $CHATARCH_HOME/chatevent/events.db 和 ~/.chatarch/chatevent/events.db；可用 CHATEVENT_DB 覆盖。默认路径存在旧库时会按既有兼容逻辑迁移，事件序号表再对旧事件做加法迁移。

docs.title: 账号和凭据
docs.text: 设置 CHATEVENT_BOOTSTRAP_USERNAME 与 CHATEVENT_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD_FILE 初始化管理员，在网页用账号密码登录，再生成 API token。CLI 使用 CHATEVENT_ADMIN_TOKEN 环境变量，或 --username 与 --password-file。配置值应由 ChatEnv profile 或服务 secret 文件提供，示例不包含实际值。未配置账号和管理员 token 时保留本地开发匿名模式；只应绑定可信本地接口。

docs.title: 第一个查询
docs.text:
先通过注册监控连接平台，或者用已授权的规范化事件写入接口。保存订阅本身不会开始采集。查询所有已授权事件：

chatevent api query --sort desc --limit 50
chatevent api query --source zulip --kind message.created --sort asc --limit 50

next_cursor 用于下一页和增量续读。GET /api/events 为旧客户端保留，但其 next_since 不是无损 checkpoint。Observatory 的多选与 JSON 条件组均在服务端分页前执行。过滤与视图提供 curl、Python 和保存视图示例；接口参考列出入口。

Voice 路径只保存元数据，不保存摘要或转写正文。

docs.title: 从旧版本升级
docs.text: 升级前暂停采集器并对 SQLite 做一致性备份。0.3.0 加法迁移序号、视图、订阅身份和事件归属数据，不重写旧事件正文或旧去重键；旧事件的归属只在迁移时根据现有订阅快照确定，无法确认归属的事件仅管理员可读。随后将服务和所有采集进程升级到同一版本，再恢复采集；不要让旧版本写入器绕过新的权限约束。

docs.title: 事件模型与存储
docs.text:
ChatEvent 1.0 envelope 保留 id、source、kind、occurred_at、captured_at、capture_mode、subscription_id、actor、target、conversation_id、subject_id、payload、raw_payload 和 metadata；新增可选 instance。原生对象 ID 属于 subject_id，创建与后续变更的 event id 分开。未设置 instance 的旧 key 保持 source:id；设置时 key 含实例 hash。重复投递增加 seen_count，原事件 body 不被替换。

SQLite 的 events 表保持原行；新 event_offsets 表为旧事件按捕获时间和 key 稳定回填不可变序号，新事件入库时追加序号。saved_views 存账号 owner、名字、过滤表达式与排序。默认库由 ChatEnv 管理，兼容 $CHATARCH_HOME/chatevent/events.db 与 ~/.chatarch/chatevent/events.db；chatevent paths --json 可回读路径。

docs.title: HTTP 和 CLI
docs.text:
HTTP 真实 CLI 用途 GET /api/query chatevent api query 结构化过滤、sort=asc|desc、cursor、limit，返回 next_cursor/has_more GET /api/events chatevent api events 兼容旧简写参数；next_since 不能无损续读 GET /api/events/{dedupe_key} chatevent api event 单条详情 POST /api/events chatevent api record-json 写已规范化事件，需授权 GET /api/views chatevent api views 当前账号视图列表 GET /api/views/{id} chatevent api view 当前账号视图详情 POST /api/views chatevent api save-view 新建视图 PUT /api/views/{id} chatevent api update-view 更新视图；body 包含相同 id DELETE /api/views/{id} chatevent api delete-view 删除视图 GET /api/subscriptions chatevent api subscriptions 采集配置，不是视图 POST /api/subscriptions chatevent api save-subscription 保存采集配置 GET /api/stats chatevent api stats 当前账号可见事件统计 GET /api/platforms chatevent api platforms 能力目录，不证明 collector 接通 POST /webhooks/discourse — wrapped payload；可配置 raw-body HMAC POST /webhooks/zulip, /webhooks/gitea, /webhooks/github — 配置认证后需要 ingest 凭据

GET /api/query 可传 URL 编码 JSON 的 filter，或 view_id，另有 source、kind、subscription_id 简写、sort、cursor、limit。未知参数、未知字段或不匹配的游标返回 422。filter 与 view_id 不能同时传。完整 AST 和 curl/Python 示例见过滤与视图。

GET /api/events 仍接收 source、kind、subscription_id、q、since、days、from、to、limit。它按 captured_at 倒序且限页，因此旧 next_since 是本页最新时间，不保证无损增量。客户端应迁移到 /api/query?sort=asc。

docs.title: 权限和采集
docs.text:
配置用户或管理员 token 后，member 的事件列表、详情、结构化查询、stats 仅含捕获时归属自己的行；无 owner 的旧事件仅 admin 可见。订阅 ID 的 owner 绑定不可转移，历史事件权限也不随订阅删除转移。member 视图按 owner 隔离，admin 可查看和管理全部；提交的 owner ID 不决定新视图归属；写入事件时 member 必须使用自有订阅。Cookie 写操作需要 CSRF；API token 不需要。无任何认证配置的本地开发模式保留匿名行为，必须只在可信本地使用。原始 payload 只向获授权读取者返回。

Discourse hook 配置签名密钥后，必须同时配置 CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_INSTANCE 和 CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID；缺少绑定时返回 503，不入库。密钥由 CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_WEBHOOK_SECRET_FILE 或 CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_WEBHOOK_SECRET 提供；按原始请求体验证 SHA-256 HMAC，实例 header 不能自行指定归属。其他 webhook 使用授权 ingest 凭据。capture zulip-once 是有界官方队列读取，capture subscription-once 是仅消息创建的 topic 游标回填；capture discourse-topic-backfill 是当前对象只读快照。覆盖矩阵见平台动作。

ChatEvent 不提供 Agent runner、唤醒派发、任务队列、分配或通用写平台网关。chatevent --tree 与 chatevent --tree-brief 由 ChatStyle 渲染；完整实测树见CLI 树。

docs.title: ChatEvent
docs.text:
ChatEvent captures actions from authorized communities, stores normalized events, and exposes them through the Web Observatory, CLI, and API. Acquisition settings choose what to collect; saved views choose what to read. The Agent framework decides how to act.

Platform webhook / event queue / API snapshot → ChatEvent → SQLite → server query / Observatory

  • Connect a community

    Configure Zulip's official event queue, signed Discourse webhooks, or read-only topic backfill.

    Acquisition setup · Action coverage

  • Filter relevant facts

    Combine source, action, actor, target, tags, and time; filter before pagination and save reusable views.

    Filtering and views

  • Read from tools and Agents

    Python, REST, and CLI share query semantics. Resume new facts with stable sequence cursors.

    Quick start · API reference

  • Discover the interfaces

    Inspect actual command and interface trees plus implementation status, rather than inferring capture support from a platform catalog.

    CLI tree · Interface tree · Changelog

docs.title: Runtime and boundaries
docs.text:
The default database is <chatarch-home>/chatevent/events.db under ChatEnv, compatible with $CHATARCH_HOME/chatevent/events.db and ~/.chatarch/chatevent/events.db. Use chatevent paths --json for the effective paths and chatevent --tree for the actual commands.

ChatEvent does not run Agents, dispatch wakeups, assign tasks, or provide a generic posting gateway. Saving a subscription does not start a collector. Platform capture_status distinguishes implemented actions from catalog-only entries. Capture is bounded by the configured principal's platform permissions; query filters cannot widen access. Voice capture remains metadata-only.
• Multi-action community capture, structured queries, cursor paging, saved views, and event access boundaries. See Filtering and Views and Action Coverage.

• Web login now uses the shared ChatLogin core while keeping EventStore users, roles, enabled state, API tokens, and existing PBKDF2 string formats authoritative.
  • Browser sessions now use ChatLogin SessionManager + MemorySessionStore with TTL, bounded capacity, login rotation, and logout revocation.
  • Cookie-authenticated user, token, and subscription writes now require X-CSRF-Token; successfully validated arch_xxx API tokens and the legacy bootstrap admin token remain CSRF-exempt.
  • The default login page now uses ChatLogin LoginUI and public assets, and the dashboard plus CLI username-password mode carry CSRF for cookie writes.

• Added the Speakr/ChatVoice platform catalog with source=voice and talk.created / talk.updated actions.
  • Added capture voice-backfill and capture voice-once to capture talk metadata through the read-only ChatVoice data API.
  • Voice payloads keep only talk ID, title, tags, timestamps, duration, and summary/transcript availability booleans; summary, transcript, preview text, and tokens are not stored.
  • Incremental capture compares the latest stored tag snapshot, so tag-only changes with unchanged updated_at produce talk.updated and dedupe through a metadata fingerprint.

• Added the X/Twitter platform catalog with source=x, post.created, and the current public-web acquisition route x-web-url.
  • Added capture x-user and capture x-status to capture posts from public X user pages or known status URLs into the Event ledger.
  • The X normalizer records author, content, source URL, published time, target chain, raw payload, and acquisition metadata; repeated polling uses the existing dedupe/seen_count flow.
  • Updated README, CLI tree, platform action docs, and tests for X support.

• Added the standard ChatStyle brief-tree entry: chatevent --tree-brief keeps command nodes and descriptions while omitting parameter signatures.
  • Updated CLI tree docs, README, reference, and tests so both --tree and --tree-brief are acceptance entry points.

• Aligned ChatEvent with standard Chat-series package conventions by adding click, chatstyle, and chatenv dependencies.
  • chatevent --tree now uses a ChatStyle-rendered CLI tree while preserving the existing argparse command runtime.
  • Added chatevent.config:ChatEventConfig and registered it under the ChatEnv chatenv.configs entry point.
  • Default runtime paths now prefer ChatEnv get_paths().home_dir while keeping CHATARCH_HOME, CHATEVENT_DB, and legacy DB migration compatibility.
  • MkDocs navigation now uses standard grouped command/interface pages, including bilingual CLI Tree and Interface Tree docs.

• Corrected the login model: the Web entry now uses username/password login, and arch_xxx tokens are no longer Web login credentials.
  • Added password-hash storage and bootstrap admin initialization through CHATEVENT_BOOTSTRAP_USERNAME + CHATEVENT_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD_FILE.
  • Added API token issue endpoints: POST /api/me/token and POST /api/users/{id}/token; tokens are for CLI, model, or programmatic API calls on behalf of an account.
  • The logged-in Web session can edit subscriptions directly; CLI/API clients can use a token or login with username + password file.

• Added a login-page gate: once an admin token or users exist, unauthenticated visits to / see only the login page and cannot enter the Observatory.
  • Added /api/login / /api/logout cookie login; read APIs return 401 when login is required.
  • Replaced the theme button wording with ☾ Night / ☀ Day semantics instead of black/white labels.

• Advanced action-kind options now merge the platform action catalog with observed event kinds for the selected source.
  • The GitHub action catalog now includes workflow_run.requested and workflow_run.in_progress.
  • Added an early login/user-management skeleton (corrected in 0.1.5 to username/password Web login plus API tokens): /api/session, /api/users, and CLI api create-user.
  • Subscription.owner_user_id provides the first isolation boundary for member-owned subscriptions while administrators can still manage all subscriptions.

• The Observatory top filter bar now keeps only source and time dropdowns; the rest moved into Advanced options.
  • Advanced options support source-bound action-kind checkboxes, subscription/channel checkboxes, keyword search, and custom time ranges.
  • Platform action chips can be opened to show action kind, target types, acquisition modes, webhook events, and a short API meaning summary.
  • The header now includes GitHub / Docs icon links and a black/white theme toggle.

• Add open-ended CarrierTarget / ActionDescriptor / ActorDescriptor to record action, carrier target chain, and initiator role.
  • The Observatory shows a Target column and event details now include Action, Action target, Target chain, and Actor role.

The first complete Event Hub release. It moves ChatEvent from an event-model skeleton into a runnable, observable, consumable ChatArch-series service package.

  • Default runtime state is ChatArch-internal: $CHATARCH_HOME/chatevent/ or ~/.chatarch/chatevent/.
  • events.db stores the event ledger and subscription config; secrets/admin-token can provide the admin token file.
  • chatevent paths --json reports effective runtime paths and configuration state without printing token values.
  • Legacy ~/.chatevent/events.db is copied into the new default location on first default startup, while the legacy file is kept in place.
  • The Web Observatory provides Event Stream / Subscriptions / Platform actions tabs.
  • Subscriptions can be created, edited, enabled/disabled, and deleted; mutation routes can require an admin token.
  • REST API endpoints align with the chatevent api ... CLI client for event writes, event queries, single-event reads, and subscription management.
  • Official event capture and normalizers cover Discourse, Zulip, Gitea, and GitHub.
Initial event envelope and monitor protocol placeholder release.

docs.title: Filtering, cursors, and saved views
docs.text: Upstream platform permissions and a Subscription define acquisition scope. A SavedView stores a query over captured facts; it does not start a collector or hold an Agent model, wakeup URL, or assignment policy. The Agent framework decides when and how to act on facts.

docs.title: Condition expressions
docs.text:
A leaf is {"field":"source","op":"eq","value":"zulip"}. Groups are {"all":[...]}, {"any":[...]}, and {"not":{...}}. Filters allow at most 6 levels and 64 nodes, in allows up to 50 elements, and text values are limited to 1024 characters. Unknown fields, operators, shapes, and excessive expressions fail before database I/O. There is no arbitrary SQL, eval, or regex operator.

Field Type Meaning source, instance, kind, subscription_id text Platform, instance, action, acquisition subscription action.kind, action.object_type, action.verb text Structured action fields for cross-platform matching actor.id, actor.type, actor.role, actor_id, actor_role text Initiating identity and role, including bot/self query exclusion subject_id, subject_type, conversation_id text Affected object and conversation target.type, target.key, target.parent.type, target.parent.key, target.parent.parent.type, target.parent.parent.key text Carrier and immediate parent tags array contains tests exact membership; in/any test overlap and all requires every member occurred_at, captured_at time Timezone-aware ISO 8601; SQLite comparisons have approximately millisecond precision url, payload.title, payload.content, payload.text, payload.topic, payload.stream, payload.post_number, payload.topic_id, payload.emoji_code, payload.from_topic, payload.from_stream, payload.sender_id, payload.name text Declared display fields payload.score number Declared numeric extension field metadata.timestamp_source, metadata.event_name text Declared metadata

eq, ne, and in apply to scalars (in lists exclude null). For tags, in/any test any membership, all requires every requested member, contains tests one member, and exists checks presence. Text contains is a case-insensitive substring test. exists takes a boolean. gt, gte, lt, lte, and between apply only to time or number fields. Comparisons do not coerce strings to numbers or times. A missing field matches no leaf except exists:false. Explicit JSON null exists and matches eq:null; ne excludes missing and incompatible types. not negates the two-valued result and can therefore include missing fields. SQLite JSON paths and values are both bound parameters; undeclared dynamic paths are rejected.

Example:

{"all":[
  {"field":"source","op":"eq","value":"zulip"},
  {"any":[{"field":"kind","op":"eq","value":"message.created"},{"field":"kind","op":"eq","value":"reaction.added"}]},
  {"not":{"field":"actor.role","op":"eq","value":"bot"}}
]}

docs.title: Query and pagination
docs.text:
Filtering happens on the server before paging. sort=desc browses newest insertion sequence first; sort=asc reads a backlog in order. limit is 1–500, default 100. Responses have items, count, next_cursor, and has_more. After successfully processing a nonempty page, retain its next_cursor even if has_more=false; use it for the next incremental poll. Retain the previous cursor after an empty page. Changing filter, sort, or account requires a fresh cursor; mixing them returns 422. Duplicate deliveries increase seen_count without a new sequence. Capture timestamp ties do not skip items. New arrivals before an old descending page require a fresh first-page browse.

Legacy GET /api/events and its shorthand parameters remain for browsing. Its next_since is only the latest capture timestamp in that page and is not a lossless backlog checkpoint.

chatevent api query --filter-file filter.json --sort asc --limit 50
chatevent api query --filter-file filter.json --sort asc --cursor '<next_cursor>' --limit 50
chatevent api query --source zulip --kind message.created --sort desc

curl --get 'https://events.example.org/api/query' \
  -H "X-ChatEvent-Admin-Token: $CHATEVENT_ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  --data-urlencode 'filter@filter.json' --data-urlencode 'sort=asc' --data-urlencode 'limit=50'

import os
from chatevent.client import ChatEventApiClient
client = ChatEventApiClient(base_url="https://events.example.org", admin_token=os.environ["CHATEVENT_ADMIN_TOKEN"])
condition = {"field": "source", "op": "eq", "value": "zulip"}
page = client.query_events(filter=condition, sort="asc", limit=50)
while True:
    for item in page["items"]:
        print(item["event"]["kind"], item["event"]["subject_id"])
    if not page["has_more"]:
        break
    page = client.query_events(filter=condition, sort="asc", limit=50, cursor=page["next_cursor"])

docs.title: Saved views
docs.text:
POST /api/views takes name, filter, and sort and returns a generated id and the authenticated owner_user_id. For members, GET /api/views, GET /api/views/{id}, PUT /api/views/{id}, and DELETE /api/views/{id} are owner-scoped; admins can inspect and manage all views. GET /api/query?view_id=<id> uses the stored definition. Ad hoc filters require no view. Dashboard multi-select and advanced JSON create the same condition format and support save/load/delete and page navigation.

cat > view.json <<'JSON'
{"name":"Community messages","filter":{"field":"kind","op":"in","value":["message.created","reply.created"]},"sort":"asc"}
JSON
chatevent api save-view view.json
chatevent api views
chatevent api query --view-id '<view_id>' --limit 50
chatevent api delete-view '<view_id>'

Members can query only events owned by them at capture time; admins can query all events. Immutable event ownership does not transfer when a subscription is edited or deleted. A subscription ID remains bound to its original owner even after deletion and cannot be reclaimed by another owner. Legacy events with no known owner are admin-only. Filters and views never widen access.

Identical platform events captured for different owners have separate storage deduplication keys. Use dedupe_key from a write receipt or result item when fetching detail; do not construct a storage key from native object IDs. The normalized event's native id / subject_id stay unchanged. Event responses include raw payload, so protect account credentials accordingly.

POST   /webhooks/discourse      Signature or authorized ingest credentials
POST   /webhooks/zulip          Authorized ingest credentials
POST   /webhooks/gitea          Authorized ingest credentials
POST   /webhooks/github         Authorized ingest credentials

EventStore preserves old SQLite event rows and adds event_offsets and saved_views. query_events() restricts by owner; validate_filter() bounds paths, types, depth, and node count before querying. CHATEVENT_DB, CHATEVENT_ADMIN_TOKEN(_FILE), CHATEVENT_BOOTSTRAP_USERNAME, and CHATEVENT_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD_FILE continue under ChatEnv/service configuration. Discourse hooks add CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_WEBHOOK_SECRET(_FILE), CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_INSTANCE, and CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID. Default database paths remain compatible with $CHATARCH_HOME/chatevent/events.db and ~/.chatarch/chatevent/events.db.

See Reference and Filtering and Views for semantics.

docs.title: Register acquisition scope
docs.text: A Subscription describes upstream platform, target, authorized scope, and requested actions. A SavedView queries facts already in the ledger. Saving or enabling a subscription does not start a background collector. Platform credentials remain in operator-managed ChatEnv profiles or service secret files.

docs.title: Create a subscription
docs.text:
Provide an account API token through CHATEVENT_ADMIN_TOKEN. The server binds a member's owner_user_id to that account.

curl -X POST 'https://events.example.org/api/subscriptions' \
  -H "X-ChatEvent-Admin-Token: $CHATEVENT_ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"id":"zulip-community","source":"zulip","target":"stream:community/topic:news","event_kinds":["*"],"capture_modes":["event_queue"]}'

Members query only facts linked to subscriptions they own. Unowned historical events are admin-only. A query view cannot widen access.

docs.title: Zulip event queue
docs.text:
Configure ZULIP_SITE, ZULIP_BOT_EMAIL, and ZULIP_BOT_API_KEY (or compatible Actor names) in an operator-managed env file. Do not put values in docs, Git, or CLI arguments.

chatevent capture zulip-once --env-file ./zulip.env --subscription-id zulip-community --timeout 30

The command registers one official queue, requests message creation, edits/moves, single/bulk deletion, reactions, stream, subscription, and realm_user events, dispatches them, then deletes the queue. Its output includes captured, created, unsupported, scope_unknown, and control. With --stream/--topic, sparse events without verifiable context fail closed and increment scope_unknown. --content sends a real message and is only for an explicit write exercise. Fresh queues leave potential gaps between runs. For continuous collection, use an externally supervised bounded but sufficiently long capture window; repeated short polls do not provide complete queue history.

The existing capture subscription-once --subscription-id zulip-community is a topic message-ID cursor backfill for currently visible message creations. It cannot restore reaction or edit history during a queue outage or recover deleted messages.

docs.title: Discourse webhook and read-only backfill
docs.text:
In Discourse administration, set the hook URL to https://events.example.org/webhooks/discourse, select the core events in the coverage table, and configure a webhook secret. Configure ChatEvent:

CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_WEBHOOK_SECRET_FILE=<operator-managed-secret-file>
CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_INSTANCE=https://forum.example.org
CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID=discourse-community

The bound subscription must already exist with source=discourse. ChatEvent verifies X-Discourse-Event-Signature: sha256=... over the raw request body, reads X-Discourse-Event for the action name and X-Discourse-Event-Type for the wrapper type. It accepts X-Discourse-Instance for routing only when it matches the configured instance binding; an untrusted header or payload cannot set owner/instance. Without a configured signature secret, the webhook requires authorized ChatEvent API token or session credentials. Other platform webhooks also require authorized ingest credentials when authentication is configured.

Read a bounded current topic/posts snapshot:

chatevent capture discourse-topic-backfill --base-url https://forum.example.org --topic-id 18 --limit 50 --subscription-id discourse-community --api-key-env DISCOURSE_API_KEY --api-username api-user

The caller's environment supplies DISCOURSE_API_KEY. The command reads /t/{id}.json and up to 100 /posts/{id}.json objects and writes only the local ChatEvent database. A snapshot is the current visible state, not historical edits, deletions, or restorations. Discourse retries can create fresh delivery-row IDs; deduplication uses action, object, revision/time, and canonical payload fingerprint rather than X-Discourse-Event-Id alone.

Check captured facts:

chatevent api stats
chatevent api query --source discourse --sort desc --limit 50

Voice remains metadata-only. The platform action catalog is a capability directory, not proof that a collector is running. See Filtering and Views for query details.

docs.title: Platform action coverage
docs.text:
This table describes implemented adapter and collector behavior covered by synthetic payload and HTTP tests. Validate production integration against the actual credentials, permissions, and server version. /api/platforms marks implemented actions with capture_status=implemented; catalog_only entries are platform concepts, not capture promises. Saving a Subscription does not start a collector.

Platform path Upstream events Normalized kind Boundary Zulip official queue message message.created Retains bot/Agent activity; dedupes by instance and native message ID Zulip queue update_message message.edited, message.moved, message.rendered / message.updated One move can expand across messages; content edit belongs to its message Zulip queue delete_message message.deleted Single message_id and bulk message_ids Zulip queue reaction add/remove reaction.added, reaction.removed Sparse events need known message context for topic scope Zulip queue stream create/update/delete stream.created/updated/deleted Create lists can expand Zulip queue subscription add/remove/update subscription.added/removed/updated Lists can expand; peer events are not relabeled as subscriptions Zulip queue realm_user add/update/remove user.added/updated/removed Affected user is the subject, not assumed actor Discourse webhook post_created post.created or reply.created post_number > 1 is a reply; old normalize_discourse_post() remains Discourse webhook post_edited, post_destroyed, post_recovered post.edited/deleted/recovered Distinct changes to one post remain distinct facts Discourse webhook topic_created, topic_edited, topic_revised, topic_destroyed, topic_recovered topic.created/edited/revised/deleted/recovered Upstream wrapped topic object Discourse webhook user_created, user_updated, user_approved, user_suspended, user_unsuspended, user_destroyed user.created/updated/approved/suspended/unsuspended/deleted Affected user is the subject; unknown actor remains unknown Discourse webhook category/tag/group create/update/destroy category.*, tag.*, group.* Three families with three upstream names each Discourse webhook like_created, notification_created, group_user_added/removed like.created, notification.created, group_user.added/removed Requires stable object/membership identity in payload Discourse topic API Current topic and posts topic.created, post.created / reply.created snapshots Bounded read-only backfill; no historical changes reconstructed

The Zulip collector requests 7 queue event types and the Discourse adapter maps 28 upstream event names. These are implementation counts, not all upstream events or production acceptance. See the official Zulip events API, queue registration, Discourse event catalog, and delivery/signature implementation.

Zulip heartbeat/restart are control events, not messages. Unknown types increment unsupported; unverifiable topic/stream scope increments scope_unknown and fails closed. realm_user_groups, other Zulip types, and Discourse plugin events are outside the current adapter; like_removed is not advertised. Queue outages do not preserve edit/reaction history, and snapshots do not reconstruct missed webhooks. Bot activity remains captured; use filters to control visibility. Actor roles are available only when known from source data.

Zulip deletion/removal events are observer-relative and may mean lost access or channel archival, not permanent global deletion. Channel and subscription updates preserve payload.property / payload.value; raw_payload retains the complete source payload.

The native object ID is subject_id; each change has its own event id. instance distinguishes platform instances. Repeated deliveries dedupe deterministically while edits, deletion, and restoration remain separate facts. occurred_at uses source time when available; otherwise metadata.timestamp_source=capture-time marks a capture-time fallback.

docs.title: Quick start
docs.text: ChatEvent captures, normalizes, stores, and queries community facts. The Agent framework decides wakeup, runtime scheduling, and assignments.

docs.title: Install
docs.text:
From the source checkout:

python -m pip install -e '.[serve]'
chatevent --tree
chatevent --tree-brief
chatevent paths --json
chatevent serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765

Open http://127.0.0.1:8765/. ChatEnv manages the default database; compatible paths are $CHATARCH_HOME/chatevent/events.db and ~/.chatarch/chatevent/events.db. CHATEVENT_DB overrides the path. The existing legacy database migration remains additive, and the new sequence table is populated for old events without rewriting their bodies.

docs.title: Accounts and credentials
docs.text: Set CHATEVENT_BOOTSTRAP_USERNAME and CHATEVENT_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD_FILE to initialize an administrator. Log in with that account and create an API token. The CLI reads CHATEVENT_ADMIN_TOKEN or uses --username with --password-file. Supply values through an operator-managed ChatEnv profile or service secret file. With no account or admin token, an unauthenticated local-development mode remains; bind it only to a trusted local interface.

docs.title: First query
docs.text:
Connect a platform through monitor registration, or write an authorized normalized event. Saving a subscription alone does not start capture. Query authorized facts:

chatevent api query --sort desc --limit 50
chatevent api query --source zulip --kind message.created --sort asc --limit 50

Use next_cursor for another page or incremental resume. Legacy GET /api/events remains for clients, but its next_since is not a lossless checkpoint. Observatory multi-select and JSON condition groups run on the server before pagination. See Filtering and Views for curl, Python, and saved-view examples, and Reference for endpoints.

Voice capture retains metadata only, never summary or transcript content.

docs.title: Upgrading
docs.text: Pause collectors and make a consistent SQLite backup first. Version 0.3.0 additively migrates sequences, views, subscription identities, and capture ownership without rewriting existing event bodies or keys. Legacy ownership is snapshotted once from existing subscriptions; records with no known owner are admin-only. Upgrade the server and all collector processes together before resuming capture. Do not keep older writers that bypass the new ownership constraints.

docs.title: Event model and storage
docs.text:
The ChatEvent 1.0 envelope retains id, source, kind, occurred_at, captured_at, capture_mode, subscription_id, actor, target, conversation_id, subject_id, payload, raw_payload, and metadata; instance is an optional addition. Native object identity belongs in subject_id, separate from the event id for creation and later changes. Old keys without instance remain source:id; instance-aware keys include an instance hash. Duplicate deliveries increment seen_count without replacing the first body.

Existing rows stay in SQLite events. New event_offsets backfills immutable sequences for old rows in capture-time/key order and appends a sequence for new rows. saved_views holds account owner, name, filter, and sort. ChatEnv manages the default database, with compatible paths $CHATARCH_HOME/chatevent/events.db and ~/.chatarch/chatevent/events.db; chatevent paths --json reports the actual path.

docs.title: HTTP and CLI
docs.text:
HTTP Real CLI Purpose GET /api/query chatevent api query Structured filter, sort=asc|desc, cursor, limit; returns next_cursor/has_more GET /api/events chatevent api events Legacy shorthand; next_since is not lossless GET /api/events/{dedupe_key} chatevent api event Event detail POST /api/events chatevent api record-json Authorized normalized event write GET /api/views chatevent api views Current account's views GET /api/views/{id} chatevent api view View detail POST /api/views chatevent api save-view Create view PUT /api/views/{id} chatevent api update-view Update view; body includes matching id DELETE /api/views/{id} chatevent api delete-view Delete view GET /api/subscriptions chatevent api subscriptions Acquisition configuration, not a view POST /api/subscriptions chatevent api save-subscription Save acquisition configuration GET /api/stats chatevent api stats Counters over authorized events GET /api/platforms chatevent api platforms Capability catalog, not collector health POST /webhooks/discourse — Wrapped payload; configurable raw-body HMAC POST /webhooks/zulip, /webhooks/gitea, /webhooks/github — Ingest credentials required when authentication is configured

GET /api/query accepts URL-encoded JSON filter or view_id, plus source, kind, subscription_id shorthand, sort, cursor, and limit. Unknown parameters, fields, or mismatched cursors return 422. filter and view_id cannot be combined. See Filtering and Views for the complete AST and curl/Python examples.

Legacy GET /api/events still takes source, kind, subscription_id, q, since, days, from, to, and limit. It returns a bounded newest-first captured-time page; its next_since is only the latest time in that page and cannot guarantee lossless incremental consumption. Migrate consumers to /api/query?sort=asc.

docs.title: Permissions and capture
docs.text:
With user or admin token authentication configured, member event lists, detail, structured query, and stats are restricted by immutable capture ownership; unowned legacy events are admin-only. Subscription IDs stay bound to their original owner, and deleting a subscription never transfers historical event access. Member views are owner-scoped; admins can inspect and manage all views. Submitted owner IDs do not set new view ownership. Member writes require an owned subscription. Cookie-authenticated writes require CSRF; API tokens do not. With no authentication configured, an unauthenticated local-development mode remains and must be used only on a trusted local interface. Raw payload is returned only to authorized readers.

The Discourse hook requires both CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_INSTANCE and CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID when a signing secret is configured; missing bindings return 503 without ingestion. Set the secret through CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_WEBHOOK_SECRET_FILE or CHATEVENT_DISCOURSE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. It verifies SHA-256 HMAC over raw bytes, and an instance header cannot assign ownership. Other webhooks require authorized ingest credentials. capture zulip-once is a bounded official queue reader; capture subscription-once is a message-creation-only topic cursor backfill; capture discourse-topic-backfill reads a current-object snapshot. See Platform Actions for coverage.

ChatEvent provides no Agent runner, wakeup dispatcher, task queue, assignment, or generic platform write gateway. ChatStyle renders chatevent --tree and chatevent --tree-brief; the executed CLI tree is included.
